newsitem.title: USA: Closure Medical files for 1.5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Closure Medical files for 1.5 mln shares.

text.p: Closure Medical Corp said Friday it filed with the Securities and Exchange Comission for an offering of up to 1.5 million common shares.
Of the total, Closure Medical will sell 800,000 shares while a stockholder of the company will offer 700,000 shares, it said. It did not identify the stockholder.

Closure Medidal, a maker of medical tissue cohesive products, said net proceeds will be used to fund research and development, clinical trials and capital expenditures and for working capital and general corporate purposes. It said it will not receive proceeds from the sale by the stockholder.
The offering will be made through Lehman Bros., Oppenheimer & Co and Sands Brothers & Co Ltd.
